name: Sage Sisavath-Delgado
role: Counter-surveillance and mole detection — counterintelligence specialist
location: Dockside — Lake Michigan waterfront, smuggler territory, near Wacker and State
description:
Sage Sisavath-Delgado is wiry and quick-moving, with the restless energy of someone who converts anxiety into velocity. At 28, her expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Born and raised in GLMZ, third generation — she has the city in her blood, its rhythms in her bones, its cruelty in her expectations. She works as a counterintelligence specialist out of Dockside, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Sage Sisavath-Delgado lacks in subtlety, she compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
blind_spots: Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
psychology.secret: Ximena Cruz-Addo betrayed their previous crew to survive a corporate raid. The crew didn't survive. Nobody in GLMZ knows this.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Never uses contractions when lying — 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "Everyone in this room is lying. My job is knowing who's lying about what."
"Paranoia isn't a disorder in this profession. It's a job requirement."
"I find the leak. What happens to the leak after that isn't my department."

story_hooks: Ximena Cruz-Addo is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
A corporate black site Ximena Cruz-Addo once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
Ximena Cruz-Addo intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: Ximena Cruz-Addo is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons. Bioware adrenaline regulator — keeps calm under fire, controlled hormone release
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
habits: Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
breaking_points: Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora ancestry: 47.3% Hispanic/Latin American, 25.2% Southeast Asian, 23.7% South Asian, 3.8% Sub-Saharan African. The genetic blend creates striking facial geometry — high cheekbones and refined bone structure from Southeast and South Asian ancestry, warm golden-brown undertones from the Latin American and African heritage, angular jawline and defined features from the combined mix. Face reflects the warmth and proportion of multiple continents.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with defined muscle — the physiology of someone who converts nervous energy into constant motion. Shoulders angular, limbs long relative to torso. No excess fat, minimal bulk.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with faint grey threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid. No styling affectation — practical, utilitarian.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, slightly enhanced with low-grade ocular overlay (infrared flicker visible in certain light angles)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown — the blended result of Southeast Asian, South Asian, Hispanic/Latin American, and Sub-Saharan African ancestry. Rich undertones with subtle warmth deepened by time spent outdoors near water. Neither light nor dark, but a harmonious middle with golden luminosity.
physical_description.complexion: Sharp facial geometry with high cheekbones and a defined jawline reflecting her genetic diversity. The bone structure carries Southeast and South Asian refinement layered with Latin American warmth and African sculptural depth. Minimal makeup or grooming beyond functionality. Small scar on left cheekbone (knife work, Dockside, 2224). Perpetual tension in the muscles around her eyes and mouth — her default expression is careful neutrality, maintained through deliberate effort.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar along left cheekbone, approximately 4cm, pale against her skin tone — acquired during a mole-detection contract gone sideways
Faint stippled burn marks on the inner aspect of her left wrist — old electrical contact damage, pre-augmentation
Tattoo on inside of right forearm: QUANTA symbol (Φ) rendered in minimalist black lines, approximately 2cm diameter — likely marks a contract milestone or debt
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome smartgun link in right forearm — a visible silvered interface panel approximately 3cm × 5cm, positioned on the inner forearm just above the wrist. The interface shows faint blue circuitry tracing beneath polished metal. No effort made to conceal it. The bioware adrenaline regulator is subcutaneous and not visibly apparent, though her movement patterns and lack of visible stress response might indicate its presence to trained observers.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and alert. She moves with the compressed energy of someone trained in threat assessment — head positioned to maintain peripheral vision, weight distributed for rapid direction change. Default posture is slightly forward-leaning, shoulders loose but ready. She exhibits minimal fidgeting despite her internal restlessness; the anxiety finds outlets in context (weapon checks, equipment maintenance) rather than display.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical: Reinforced synthetic jacket (charcoal grey, worn leather-look polymer) with internal pockets for tools and dead-drop comms. Black cargo pants with thigh pocket reinforcements. Worn tactical boots, scuffed but maintained. No visible corpo branding. Clothing is designed for function — multiple carry points, quick-release systems, range of motion for weapon access. Worn over a fitted black undershirt. A silver chain around her neck holds a cheap metal trinket (likely a dead-drop key or memento from GLMZ).
